notes:
Lead background:
- Founded 2020, YC-ish early-stage sales enablement SaaS. Building call-summary + coaching layer on top of CRM.
- Primary customers: SMB sales teams (5-200 users). Heavy on Google Workspace and HubSpot CRM integrations.
Why reached out:
- Interested in hosted, self-serve Redwood API to power realtime call summarization and per-rep coaching cards. Wants low-friction onboarding for devs + simple pricing for small teams.
Security / PII concerns (main thread):
- Requirement: transcripts cannot retain raw phone numbers or SSNs beyond 30 days. "We can't store PII longer than necessary" (Head of Ops).
- Wants server-side redaction examples + best-practice pattern: client-side masking vs. API-side redaction.
- Needs retention controls per-organization and per-contact; ability to delete transcripts on demand.
- As an SMB they don't require full on-prem but want clear docs on data residency (NA) and audit logs.
Product preferences / technical constraints:
- Prefer hosted_api initially (self-serve). Public cloud OK (AWS us-east primary).
- Latency target: 1.0-1.5s for summary generation after call ends; throughput modest (10-30 concurrent summaries).
- Cost sensitivity: tight budget, prefer predictable per-minute pricing or sandbox credits.
- Model preferences: open models fine but want Redwood verified performance profiles; fallback to cheaper variant during spikes.
